name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support and risk cover to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising out of unforeseen natural events.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: All farmers growing notified food, oilseeds, and commercial crops in notified areas
benefits: Complete insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses, with nominal farmer premium rates (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi, 5% commercial/horticultural) and balance subsidized by Government.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: National crop insurance scheme covering all notified crops in participating states across India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers cultivating notified crops in notified insurance units.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Full sum insured protection against natural calamities with low actuarial premium rates capped at 1.5% to 5% for farmers.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
source_evidence.citation: Section 4, Premium Slabs and Claim Settlement

source_evidence.statement: Official National Crop Insurance Portal hosted at pmfby.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

source_evidence.statement: Active nationwide implementation with DigiClaim module enabling direct automated insurance payouts to farmer bank accounts.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Crops must be cultivated in state-notified areas during eligible agricultural season.

required_documents.title: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: UIDAI Aadhaar card for farmer identity.

required_documents.title: Land Ownership Record / Tenancy Certificate
required_documents.description: RoR, Khasra, Khatauni or registered tenancy agreement showing sown land.

required_documents.title: Bank Passbook
required_documents.description: Bank account details with IFSC code for claim remittance.

required_documents.title: Sowing Certificate / Self-Declaration
required_documents.description: Certificate from Patwari / Gram Panchayat or self-declaration of crop sowing.
